name: Baybrook Square
summary: Baybrook Square is a dominant power center located across from Baybrook Mall at Interstate 45 and West Bay Area Boulevard in Webster, Texas. The center serves the Clear Lake and Bay Area Houston communities with convenient access to diverse retail, dining, and service options.
demographics: Baybrook Square attracts a diverse middle to upper-middle income demographic from the Webster and Clear Lake area, including families, young professionals, and NASA employees from nearby Johnson Space Center. The trade area serves a population with household incomes ranging from $60,000 to $100,000+, with a strong presence of dual-income households and homeowners. Shoppers are typically between 25-54 years old, seeking convenient access to everyday retail, dining, and services. The center benefits from its proximity to Baybrook Mall, capturing cross-shopping traffic and serving as a complementary retail destination for the Bay Area Houston community.
description: Baybrook Square is a dominant power center strategically located across from Baybrook Mall on West Bay Area Boulevard in Webster, Texas. Positioned at the intersection of Interstate 45 and West Bay Area Boulevard, this shopping destination serves the thriving Clear Lake and Bay Area Houston communities with convenient access to a wide variety of retail, dining, and service options. The center's prime location near NASA's Johnson Space Center and major employment hubs makes it a go-to destination for both residents and professionals in the area. As a power center, Baybrook Square offers ample parking and easy accessibility, featuring a diverse tenant mix that caters to everyday shopping needs and lifestyle preferences. The property is managed by FRP Ltd., a company specializing in retail, healthcare, residential, and industrial properties, ensuring professional management and ongoing tenant services.
